Danmar Empire Real Estate Corp., Brokerage

Danmar Empire is a family-owned real estate brokerage founded in Oakville, Ontario in 2016 by Martin Sheikhan, Broker of Record, and Daniel Sheikhan, Managing Partner and Broker, who is called to the bar in Ontario and admitted in New York and Minnesota. The brokerage is registered with the Real Estate Council of Ontario, keeps offices in Oakville and Vaughan, and is licensed to act throughout Ontario. It acts for clients as a real estate brokerage and does not provide legal services. About the firm and its people: https://danmarempire.com/firm

The firm works in four practices.

Asset management: private real estate portfolios from $10 million to $250 million, in Ontario and abroad, managed on a discretionary or advisory basis, with a written quarterly report covering each asset, income against budget, lease expiries, debt maturities and capital. https://danmarempire.com/asset-management

Investments: income property, land with approvals in hand and single-tenant net lease across the Greater Toronto Area and the Ontario secondary markets, underwritten at the firm's cost before an asset is presented. Rent rolls and reports are released under a confidentiality agreement, not published. https://danmarempire.com/investments

Private sales: residential property above $1.5 million, listed by the brokerage and shown in The Collection. https://danmarempire.com/collection

Executive leasing: tenancies from $10,000 per month, acting for landlords and for relocation departments, with the tenant's guarantee qualified before a lease is signed. https://danmarempire.com/executive-leasing

The Collection shows the brokerage's own listings only. There is no MLS search and no map on the site. Prices shown are list prices. Off-market listings are never published: no address, price, photograph or page for them appears anywhere on the site, and their particulars are shared only on enquiry. https://danmarempire.com/collection

Relocating: the firm advises families relocating to the Greater Toronto Area from abroad, chiefly to Oakville, King City and central Toronto. The usual advice is to lease first, for twelve to twenty-four months, and to buy once the family has lived a winter in the area. The sequence is an orientation before anything is committed, a lease, introductions to banking, credit and counsel, and then the purchase. https://danmarempire.com/relocating

Selected transactions, with list prices published with the consent of the parties: https://danmarempire.com/track-record
Areas served, from Oakville and Toronto to Muskoka and Niagara: https://danmarempire.com/areas
Market reports and field notes: https://danmarempire.com/journal
Offices and enquiries: https://danmarempire.com/contact
